description: This file provides utility classes, functions, and mock implementations for testing URLRequest and network delegate components within the Chromium project. It includes classes for creating test URL request contexts, delegates, network delegates, test servers, and URL interceptors, as well as external file references and method calls used in testing network request behaviors.

classes.name: TestURLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Provides a dummy URLRequestContext for testing, living on a specified message loop.

classes.name: TestDelegate
classes.description: Implements URLRequest::Delegate for testing, capturing request events and states.

classes.name: TestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Mocks network delegate behavior for testing request handling and event tracking.

classes.name: FilteringTestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Extends TestNetworkDelegate with cookie filtering capabilities for testing cookie policies.

classes.name: HttpTestServer
classes.description: A simple embedded test server with default handlers for testing network requests.

classes.name: TestScopedURLInterceptor
classes.description: Sets up a URLRequestInterceptor for intercepting specific URL requests during tests.

methods.name: CreateTestURLRequestContextBuilder
methods.description: Creates a URLRequestContextBuilder preconfigured for testing.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext associated with this getter.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner for network operations.

methods.name: NotifyContextShuttingDown
methods.description: Notifies that the context is shutting down.
